title: Quality threshold changes support
selection_rationale: Selected to show all three exact-hit traces with independently retrievable retained reads, including the single Q20-passing signature.
display_scope: All three exact-hit traces for this selected cell; complete-cell counters remain separate from the displayed spans.
interpretation: The exact target string is observed in three distinct retained read-pair signatures. Two exact-hit spans contain a Phred score below 20, leaving one Q20 signature, below the two-signature threshold. This is a quality/support effect, not evidence that the target is absent from the genome.

title: Two observed strings jointly cover the target words
selection_rationale: Selected as the lexicographically first accession among the four inherited phased-complementation examples, with two supported strings.
display_scope: Two existing supported phased strings; support counts refer to their inherited consistent sequence-pair signatures.
interpretation: Each supported phased string differs from the catalog target and lacks some target 31-mers, while their union contains every target 31-mer. This illustrates observed word-set complementation. The strings and primary reference placements do not establish complete genomic haplotypes or target absence.

title: An extra repeat preserves short words
selection_rationale: Selected because this is the sole inherited same-read k31 discrepancy and an authentic 117-base observed segment is retained.
display_scope: One authentic 117-base exact-hit read, supported by its sequence-pair hash and original per-base quality.
interpretation: One retained Q20 read contains the complete 117-base extra-repeat string and every target 31-mer, but not the original exact 82-base target. The selected-cell census has four Q20 same-read signatures and zero exact signatures. The single displayed read is not that census. The repeat permits multiple equivalent insertion alignments, so the drawing does not locate a unique genomic breakpoint.

title: An unresolved pooled-word discrepancy
selection_rationale: Selected to retain an unresolved case with short-word support and no same-pair support; no observed alternative full-span string is invented.
display_scope: Catalog target and complete selected-cell evidence counts only; no observed alternative sequence is available in this illustration.
interpretation: The selected-cell census supports every target 31-mer separately, but no same-pair signature meets the complete word-set requirement. Primary reference placements are suggestive of split regions. The biological mechanism remains unresolved; neither an alternative full-span sequence nor genomic absence is inferred.
